facts.fact: In a one-way referral program, the company rewards only the existing customer (referrer) for recommending its store, product, or service to friends and family.
facts.quote: the company rewards an existing customer (referrer) for recommending their store, product, or service to their friends and family.

facts.fact: In a two-way referral program, the company offers incentives to both the referrer and the referred customer upon sign-up or first purchase.
facts.quote: The company offers incentives to both the referrer and the referred customers upon sign-up or when they make their first purchase.
